english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, situation, or prospect with no positive outcome in sight.
Use this when a plan, attempt, or situation is unlikely to succeed.

examples.jyutping: ni1 daan1 saang1 ji3 mou5 hei1 mong6 laa3

examples.english: If we keep dragging this out, this plan is truly forlorn and will not succeed.
examples.traditional: 再咁樣拖落去，呢個計劃真係冇希望成功。
examples.jyutping: zoi3 gam3 joeng2 to1 lok6 heoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 mou5 hei1 mong6 sing4 gung1
